Oneliner

Precursor to a constellation with multiple payloads.
Description

Precursor to a constellation of 12 spacecraft. Multiple payloads, including a multispectral camera, synthetic aperture radar, automatic identification system (AIS) for tracking ships and Automatic dependent surveillance – broadcast (ADS-B) for tracking aircraft.
